text.tspan: Kinesis Data Streams: collect and store streaming data in real time
record = partition key + data blob (up to 1 MiB, can raise
to 10 MiB per stream since Oct 2025). Same partition key
→ same shard → ORDERED. Retention 24 h - 365 days.
• You choose the number of shards; scale manually
• Per shard: IN 1 MB/s or 1,000 records/s
• Per shard: OUT 2 MB/s shared by all consumers
(enhanced fan-out: 2 MB/s per shard PER consumer)
• Pay per shard provisioned per hour
• No capacity to provision or manage
• Scales automatically to 2x the peak write seen in
the last 30 days (up to 200 MB/s; 10 GB/s in
• Pay per stream per hour + data in/out per GB
• Consumers can REPROCESS (replay) data · data can't be deleted until it expires · at rest KMS, in flight HTTPS
• KPL (Kinesis Producer Library) = optimized producer app · KCL (Kinesis Client Library) = optimized consumer app
• Switch capacity mode at most twice per 24 h per stream
